title: EventBus final callback removal registry cleanup contract

contract.final_callback_removal: Removing the final callback for an event succeeds
contract.event_registry_cleanup: The event key is removed from the listener registry when its final callback is unregistered
contract.registry_cleanup: The listener registry becomes fully empty after the final callback is removed
contract.post_clear_emit: Emitting an event after all listeners are removed succeeds
contract.delivery_absence: No callback is invoked after the listener registry has been cleared
contract.registry_stability: Final callback removal leaves the EventBus registry in a clean state
contract.permission_enforcement: Register, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
